device.name: Masterflex Ismatec Reglo ICC peristaltic pump

facts.text: The package controls a Masterflex Ismatec Reglo ICC digital peristaltic pump over its USB interface; the RS-232 interface is untested
The package needs Python >= 3.6 and pyserial >= 3.5
A command is written as ASCII text followed by a carriage return
A query response is read until CRLF (read_until(b'\r\n'))
The initialization command is '{pump_addr}~1', which puts the pump in remote-control mode
The pump reports its number of channels to '{addr}xA', its serial number to '{addr}xS' and its model, software version and head code to '{addr}#'
get_max_flow_rate returns the maximum flow rate setting for the installed tubing in mL/minute
set_tubing_id takes the tubing inner diameter in mm and sends it as hundredths of a millimetre in a four-digit field
set_tubing_id stores the value the pump reports back in tubing_ids for that channel
The tubing inner diameter must match one of the values listed in the pump documentation
pump_vol takes the volume in mL and the rate in mL/minute; the direction is a PumpDirection (CW or CCW)
dispense_vol uses the channel's configured dispense direction and aspirate_vol uses the opposite direction
The default dispense direction is CW
PumpDirection is the pump rotor rotation direction as viewed from the front: CW or CCW
stop(ch_no) immediately stops the specified channel, and stop(None) stops every channel
is_running returns True while the channel is pumping and False when it is not
The driver stops a channel and raises StallDetectionDetected when is_running reports the channel running but its odometer has not counted up for 2 seconds
Volumes and rates are encoded with four significant digits in type-2 format ('{mantissa}{exponent:+d}')
